findings.finding: Step 16 contradicts its own cross-repository boundary. It says no file under /opt/eco/docs is written by this plan and publication is PM-owned, but its Error Handling says a cross-repo write is attempted and its Edge Cases instruct creation of docs/aid/specs/ plus a sidebars.ts registration there. The implementer cannot determine whether those external writes are in scope.
findings.recommendation: Choose one boundary: remove all external-write instructions and provide only an in-repo PM handoff package, or declare a separately authorized PM-owned docs subtask with its own completion gate.

findings.finding: The test-tier plan conflicts with the repository: test-fsm-step-render.bats is currently tagged '# aid-tier: t2', while the plan classifies it as T0/T1 merge-blocking and says its existing tier is preserved. T0/T1 is not an executable tag choice, and Step 15 directly reruns only the two named T2 suites, excluding this suite if its existing T2 tag is preserved. Consequently the Step 13 regression is not assured to run on the merge path or in the final declared verification.
findings.recommendation: Assign one exact tier to every new or modified suite. Explicitly change test-fsm-step-render.bats to the selected T0/T1 tag if merge coverage is required, or classify it as T2 and directly invoke it in Step 15; align the tiering section, Step 13, and Step 15.

findings.finding: The plan-level grandfathering decision says Steps 3, 5, and 6 each carry their own test-skill-lint Files entry and lint-clean AC. Step 6 modifies aid-init.md and aid-setup.md after Step 5 delists them, but Step 6 has neither the test file in its Files list nor a lint-clean acceptance check. Step 15 also does not name test-skill-lint.sh among its explicit T2 reruns.
findings.recommendation: Add the skill-lint test and explicit lint commands for both modified files to Step 6, and include that check in the final regression invocation or assign it an appropriate verified tier.
